g.text: Monday 20 July, 09:40. Mensah's instinct is the careful officer's instinct: give it everything about
Pellmar. Every notice, every minute, every email that names it.
You expect the answers to get worse, and say so. Every guide you have read says they will.
You run the questions with the two statements that answer them. Then with four more pages that mention
Pellmar and answer nothing. Then eight. Then twelve. Okafor keeps the tally.
"Not one answer moved," you say. "What moved is how much room is left."
## MTB standing instruction PNL-S4, schedule as lodged 9 June 2026
Meridian Trust Bank holds standing instruction PNL-S4 for Pellmar Nominees Ltd re Reserve 2. The schedule
as lodged lists six transfers, PNL-S4-001 to PNL-S4-006. The sixth was withdrawn by Pellmar on 16 June and
Harbour Telecom to Halcyon Logistics Ltd. Line rental for 14 lines: 1,120.00. Calls: 386.40. Total
1,506.40. Paid by direct debit on 28 January.
pages about two suppliers the inquiry closed in April,
answers any of the signed questions and none says anything false. Several carry a figure, a date or a
reference that looks like one in the statements.
. Add the related pages, four at a time
The evidence slice, with pages about Pellmar added
Every answer held. On these questions and this model, twelve related pages were not enough to move one. What
. The same weight of unrelated pages
. A cut-off, and a record of what was left out
The 26 signed questions, three ways of treating the pages
"How much did Corvane Trading Ltd pay into the reserve MTB-31-02290 on ..."
"Who is the protector of Tidewater Holdings Trust?..."
"Which accounts does Pellmar Nominees administer under Schedule 1 of HA..."
left out, each with its score in .scratch/
left out is a decision somebody may have to defend, so the builder writes it down.
Twelve true pages about Pellmar were added to the context, 961 tokens, none of which answers a signed
question. The eight questions answered by the statements went from 8 of 8 to 8 with four pages, 8 with
eight and 8 with twelve. Twelve pages about telephone bills and stationery, 839 tokens, left 8 of 8.
Over all 26 questions the baseline passes 17; with every page about Pellmar loaded it passes 18; with a
cut-off that admitted 5 pages over the 26 questions it passes 17, and every page left out is on record
with its score. The pages cost no answers. They cost 966 of the 1,586 tokens the budget had to spare.
